pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal patches with irregular, non-linear edge gradients exhibiting high contrast against the interstitial corridors. Patch scale is largest on the mid-neck and upper shoulder, decreasing in area towards the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-colored pathways characterized by variable pixel thickness. The topological graph is composed of tri-radiate and tetra-radiate junction nodes, with pathway continuity maintained across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents as a raised, dark-brown ridge with a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette. Individual hair bundles create a fine-grained serrated edge against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct concave discontinuity in the mane height is visible at the junction where the neck meets the dorsal hump.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, out-of-focus horizontal linear feature (likely foreground vegetation) bisects the lower thoracic and abdominal regions of the subject.
